title: How to declare my attributes for faceting ?

comments.body:
Hi Clementvp, you need to declare the attributes for faceting in the dashboard OR use the REST settings call to set them from a script for instance that would run on your infrastructure: https://www.algolia.com/doc/rest#change-index-settings

The JS client has a setSettings method: https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-js#index-settings

Then once the attributes for faceting are defined in your settings, you can use any refinementList or menu or hierarchicalMenu widget.

Let me know how it goes.
